verdict.rationale: Motion's own feature page explicitly says it combines Outlook, Google, and iCloud calendar accounts into one interface and promises "Never get double-booked". That covers every provider named in the story and its conflict-avoidance goal. The evidence is only short marketing copy, though, with no detail on how cross-calendar conflict checking actually works. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of conflict detection across all connected calendars (sync behavior, whether booking pages check every calendar), independent or hands-on corroboration.
